verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say it supports adding MCP servers to extend it with custom tools. A CLI command (`npx poke@latest mcp add <url>`) adds a remote server, and a tunnel command exposes a local one. The integrations docs say any MCP-compatible server can be connected directly, and Poke sends a per-user `X-Poke-User-Id` header on every request to the server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connected MCP tools work reliably in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Poke supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, allowing you to extend Poke with custom tools and data sources.
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
If the service you want isn't available as a Recipe, you can connect any MCP-compatible server directly
npx poke@latest tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp -n "Local Dev MCP"
